note: Hard B, lineage reading: base.json names this recipe's mother, so the declared difference is against that recipe -- not against the framework stock cfg, which would bury this version's own delta in everything its ancestors wrote. Env paths are grouped by who wrote them: the element set that touched the path (several elements can touch one path in sequence), a version-resolved component, or wiring -- the shared wiring reading this recipe's own document. params_version is filtered as identity: it says which recipe this is, and it is what makes the two recipes different at all.
